title: Fravor and Dietrich saw appendages on Underwood's FLIR tape
place_text: USS Nimitz area, off Southern California

tellings.quote: both commander uh Fraver and uh Lieutenant Commander Dietrich have stated that when they reviewed Underwood's tapes afterwards, they saw these little appendages, these protrusions.

plain: In 2004, off Southern California, Navy pilots met a white oval object, and the infrared camera video of it later showed small appendages sticking out of it, according to two of the pilots. Marik von Rennenkampff relays this on Michels' show: Commander David Fravor and Lieutenant Commander Alex Dietrich have said they saw these protrusions when they reviewed the tape filmed by a pilot named Chad Underwood. He raises it as a detail that a plain balloon or plane would not explain.
